title: Beavers and River Ecosystems
hook: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.

scenes.narration: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.
In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations, with combined population numbers being estimated at 1,200 individuals.
These populations were estimated for the Rhone of France, the Elbe in Germany, and southern Norway.
Populations were also estimated for the Neman river and Dnieper Basin in Belarus, and the Voronezh river in Russia.
River ecosystems are flowing waters that drain the landscape, and include biotic interactions amongst plants, animals, and micro-organisms.
Abiotic physical and chemical interactions of its many parts also occur within these flowing waters that drain the landscape.
The major zones in river ecosystems are determined by the river bed's gradient or by the velocity of the current.
In addition, wolves often kept animals from grazing in riparian areas, which protected beavers from having their food sources encroached upon.
